item.title: Cabbage Beach Fence, Grand Lucayan Pay, MSC Investment
item.ns0:title: Cabbage Beach Fence, Grand Lucayan Pay, MSC Investment
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, chaotic scenes erupt at Cabbage Beach as vendors and political activists pull down a re-erected fence blocking beach access, while a former Grand Lucayan Resort employee battling cancer makes a heartbreaking appeal for overdue severance pay. Meanwhile, Attorney General Wayne Munroe doubles down on his criticism of unauthorized undercover U.S. DEA operations in The Bahamas, and Bay Street Straw Market vendors return to work following a major two-day deep cleaning. Plus, we bring you the latest court arraignments, major updates in tourism leadership, and your full sports and weather forecast!
